name: Maasai Mara & Coast
about: Long dry season Jun–Oct brings the migration river crossings; Palearctic migrant birds arrive Nov–Mar.
overview: The classic East African safari paired with Swahili coast beaches — big-cat plains inland, dhows and coral reefs on the Indian Ocean.
costOverview: Maasai Mara Reserve fees are among the highest in Africa, climbing further in peak season — coastal Mombasa and Diani stay comparatively affordable.

specialSeasons.text: This is peak Great Migration season, with wildebeest herds making dramatic Mara River crossings.
